description: This Kotlin source file defines a Compose UI component for a chat input interface, including input handling, attachment management, and control buttons, within an Android application.

classes.name: DraftApplication
classes.description: Data class representing a draft message with input text, last applied draft, and consumed status.

methods.name: applyDraftText
methods.description: Function to determine whether to update the draft input based on the current draft text, last applied draft, and user input.

methods.name: ChatComposer
methods.description: Main composable function providing a chat input UI with message input, attachments, control buttons, and dropdown for thinking levels.

methods.name: SecondaryActionButton
methods.description: Helper composable for rendering small action buttons with icons and labels.

methods.name: ThinkingMenuItem
methods.description: Helper composable for dropdown menu items representing different thinking levels.

methods.name: AttachmentsStrip
methods.description: Displays a scrollable strip of attachments with options to remove each.

methods.name: AttachmentChip
methods.description: Displays individual attachment with filename and remove option.

methods.name: chatTextFieldColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for the message input text field.

methods.name: mobileBodyStyle
methods.description: Defines typography style used in the text input.
